scripts.tokens: node ./tools/space-shape.mjs && node ./tools/colour.mjs && node ./tools/token-contexts.mjs && node ./agentic-craft/tools/build-tokens.mjs --src packages/core/tokens --css packages/core/css/tokens.css --json packages/core/tokens/generated/tokens.resolved.json && node ./tools/template-tokens.mjs
scripts.tokens:check: node ./tools/space-shape.mjs --check && node ./tools/colour.mjs --check && node ./tools/token-contexts.mjs --check && node ./agentic-craft/tools/build-tokens.mjs --src packages/core/tokens --css packages/core/css/tokens.css --json packages/core/tokens/generated/tokens.resolved.json --check && node ./agentic-craft/tools/check-tokens.mjs --src packages/core/tokens --checks packages/core/tokens/checks.json && node ./tools/template-tokens.mjs --check
scripts.build:library: npm run tokens && npm run build -w apps/library
scripts.colour:types: tsc packages/core/colour/index.mjs --allowJs --declaration --emitDeclarationOnly --skipLibCheck --target ES2022 --module ESNext --moduleResolution Bundler --outDir packages/core/colour
